datasets.name: DatSetCreditArchView
datasets.sql:
select 
       p.hdate,
       p.numberofcredit,
       cm_common.Get_CreditCurrency(p.currency) as val_name,
       p.creditlineamount,
       p.annualyinterestrate,
       p.annualyoverduerate,
       p.annualypenaltyrate,
       p.dateofconclusion,
       p.duedatefirstcontract,
       p.purposeofcredit,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.Get_userNameByID(p.op_id) as op_id ,
       /*nvl(*/p.defCalcInt/*,1)*/ as defCalcInt,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_custname(p.boorowerid) as custname,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_catdesc(p.customertype) as catdescription,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_perdesc(p.personaltype) as perdescripion,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_crdtypedesc(p.credittype) as crdtypedescription,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_usergrdesc(p.usrgroup) as usrgrdescription,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_filialname(p.branchid) as filname,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get(p.loanaccid) as LoanAccNo,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get(p.Interestaccid) as InterestAccNo,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get(p.DueLoanaccid) as DueLoanAccNo,
       cm_common.accountnumber_get(p.DueInterestaccid) as DueInterestAccNo,
       CM_AK_REPORTS.get_creditcalcmethod(INTCALCMETHOD) as Calcmethod
from 
  cm_portfolio_archive p
where  p.id = :CrdID
